independent_computation.step_1_effect: Bloodsong's unique Spellblade passive: after an ability cast, the next basic attack within 10 s deals 100% base AD bonus physical on-hit; against a champion it additionally applies the debuff 'Expose Weakness' for 4 s (1.5 s cooldown, starting after the empowered attack).
independent_computation.step_2_magnitude: Expose Weakness magnitude in the cached wiki text is the template {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources.
independent_computation.step_3_template_resolution: {{rd|A|B}} resolves to A for a melee holder and B for a ranged holder (established from Doran's Shield's explicit 'trigger this effect with the ranged values' sentence and from items with independently known melee/ranged splits: Cleave 40%/20% AD, Titanic Hydra 1%/0.5% max health). Therefore Expose Weakness = 8% increased damage if the Bloodsong holder is MELEE, 5% if the holder is RANGED.
independent_computation.step_4_to_multiplier: 'Increased damage from all sources' is an outgoing/incoming damage amplification, i.e. a multiplicative factor on the damage instance: multiplier = 1 + amp. Melee: 1 + 0.08 = 1.08. Ranged: 1 + 0.05 = 1.05.
independent_computation.step_5_result: multiplier = 1.08 for a melee Bloodsong holder; multiplier = 1.05 for a ranged Bloodsong holder. The published leaf value 1.08 equals exactly the melee branch of the sourced text, with the correct attribution string 'Bloodsong — Expose Weakness'.
independent_computation.step_6_old_value: <absent> is inconsistent with the source whenever the scenario's Bloodsong support actually lands an ability-empowered basic attack on the enemy champion at or before this event: the wiki text makes the amplification apply 'from all sources' for 4 s, so an absent multiplier understates every damage instance inside that window. Absent is only correct if the debuff never lands or the event lies outside the 4 s window — a condition the golden leaf itself contradicts by authoring the debuff on this event.

The alternative failure mode (holder is ranged) requires a specific roster fact, whereas 'absent' is wrong under every reading in which the debuff lands.
